items.title: 75234_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: Harriet Calloway was...she claimed to be Cab's sister, but she really wasn't -- because I found that out from the manager of the band.

ctx.x: I remember I said, 'Well, I've heard of Blanche Calloway, but I've never heard of Harriet Calloway.' So tell that story.

Well, Harriet Calloway was...she claimed to be Cab's sister, but she really wasn't -- because I found that out from the manager of the band. He liked her and he was booking her. The trumpet player, I think I told you about him.
